web.listen_address.description: Host and port to listen on for Prometheus scraping (e.g., ':9256' or '127.0.0.1:9256')

procfs.path.description: Path to the Linux proc filesystem

sysfs.path.description: Path to the Linux sys filesystem; leave empty to omit (optional)

process.include_patterns.description: List of process name patterns to monitor; others will be ignored. Supports wildcards and 're:'-prefixed regex

process.exclude_patterns.description: List of process patterns to explicitly exclude from metrics

items.description: A process name pattern to exclude

metrics.collect_threads.description: Enable collection of per-thread CPU and memory metrics

metrics.collect_init.description: Include metrics for the init process (PID 1)

web.timeout.description: Maximum duration for HTTP request handling (e.g., '15s', '1m')

web.max_requests.description: Maximum number of concurrent HTTP requests; 0 means unlimited

tls.enabled.description: Enable TLS for the metrics endpoint

tls.config_file.description: Path to the TLS configuration file (YAML format) — required only if TLS is enabled

extra_args.description: Additional command-line arguments to pass to the exporter (e.g., ['-debug', '-log.level=warn'] — only add if needed)

items.description: A single CLI flag or argument (e.g., '-debug' or '-log.format=json')
